notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.notes:
GENERAL
- Overall performance optimization
- Increased intensity audio reactive visualizers 

FREESTYLE
We moved the freestyle mode to 3D space. By moving and rotating your controllers you can shape your own sound. Each controller represents an oscillator which you can configure.
- Horizontal distance between controllers determines note
- Rotation left controller determines resonance effect
- Rotation right controller determines cutoff effect
- Vertical distance between controllers determines LFO
- Configure Oscillator type (Sine, Square, Sawtooth, Triangle) per controller
- Adjust base octave per controller
- Adjust note offset per controller
- Not synced over the network (yet)

MULTIPLAYER
- Added voice chat
